BusinessModel: Company makes two-wheeler helmets and riding gear. Sells under Studds (mass market) and SMK (premium) brands. Ranks as world's second-largest helmet maker by volume.
RevenueStreams: Helmets (majority of sales; helmet vs accessories split data not found); premium SMK brand growing; domestic plus exports
Expenses: Raw materials (ABS, polycarbonate, EPS) dominate - exact % data not found; OPM ~20% (FY26)
TAM: Indian two-wheeler helmet market ~Rs 8,000-12,000 crore (estimate; sourced figure data not found)

BusinessModel: Company turns sugarcane into sugar, ethanol, bio-based chemicals and power at one integrated biorefinery. Part of Somaiya Group. Largest Indian MPO maker; one of two global makers of natural 1,3-Butylene Glycol.
RevenueStreams: Integrated mix of sugar, ethanol, bio-based chemicals, power (segment % data not found); revenue Rs 1,965 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Cane cost dominates - exact % data not found; OPM ~6% (FY26); interest on Rs 525 crore debt
TAM: India ethanol blending (E20) procurement market; sugar industry ~Rs 1.5+ lakh crore (sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Ethanol realisation and government blending price; sugar price vs cane cost; speciality chemical margins (MPO, 1,3-BG)

BusinessModel: Company runs managed and co-working office spaces, focused on Tier-2 cities. Also does design and fit-outs, payroll/facility services and IT services.
RevenueStreams: Managed/co-working flex space (core); design and execution (Neddle & Thread); payroll/facility management; IT services; revenue Rs 171 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Lease rentals on centres - largest head; finance cost ~26% of sales (FY26); borrowings Rs 226 crore

RevenueStreams: LMS and assessment platform licences/subscriptions (majority); services; revenue Rs 273 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Employee cost dominates (software firm; exact % data not found); OPM ~26% (FY26); interest down to Rs 4 crore (FY25)
TAM: Global ed-tech/digital assessment market in tens of billions USD; Indian online education multi-billion USD (sourced figure data not found)

RevenueStreams: Product sales online plus offline stores (majority); GMV Rs 10,585 crore (FY25); standalone revenue Rs 2,732 crore (FY26); other income Rs 211 crore (TTM)
Expenses: Cost of goods dominates; fulfilment and logistics; advertising/discount spend - exact % data not found; OPM ~3.6% (FY26)
TAM: India baby-care market ~USD 10+ billion growing 10-15% yearly (estimate; sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Product gross margin; fulfilment/logistics costs; advertising and discount spend plus other income

RevenueStreams: TPA claims processing fees (core); network and hospital management; policy administration services; revenue Rs 225 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Asset-light; OPM ~36% (FY26); minimal debt Rs 5 crore; employee cost main head (exact % data not found)
TAM: Indian health insurance premium pool ~Rs 1.2+ lakh crore growing 15-20% yearly (sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Claims volume growth from insurance penetration; automation-driven margin leverage (OPM 5% FY23 to 36% FY26); network management fees

BusinessModel: Company owns and runs 13 luxury hotels and resorts (2,178 keys) in India, Maldives and Sri Lanka. Operates them under Marriott, Hilton, Minor and Atmosphere brands.
RevenueStreams: Luxury hotel room revenue (~80% luxury focus); F&B and banquets; other income Rs 106 crore (FY26); revenue Rs 638 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Hotel operating costs; finance cost on Rs 862 crore borrowings; OPM ~49% (FY26)
TAM: India tourism/hospitality ~USD 100+ billion trajectory; luxury segment outgrowing mid-market (sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Maldives resort room revenue (dollar earnings); Indian luxury hotel F&B/banquets; other income and finance costs on Rs 862 crore debt

BusinessModel: Company builds power transmission lines, distribution networks, water infrastructure and railway projects on a turnkey basis. Handles design through commissioning.
RevenueStreams: Power transmission and distribution EPC (core); water infrastructure; railway electrification; revenue Rs 1,249 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Raw materials - steel, conductors, cables - dominate (exact % data not found); OPM ~14% (FY26); interest on Rs 301 crore debt
TAM: India power transmission capex several lakh crore over next decade; railway electrification and water spend add more (sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Execution pace on transmission/DISCOM orders; raw material (steel) costs; working capital interest - 296 debtor days

BusinessModel: Company makes pre-engineered buildings - factory sheds, warehouses and industrial structures from steel, with in-house design. Two divisions cover design and manufacture/erection.

Expenses: Steel/raw materials dominate (exact % data not found); expenses 89% of sales (FY26); borrowings cut to Rs 84 crore
TAM: Indian PEB market ~Rs 15,000-20,000 crore growing 10-15% yearly (estimate; sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Steel cost vs contract prices; order-book execution and utilisation; operating leverage (OPM 8% FY23 to 11-13% FY25-26)

BusinessModel: Company mines and processes natural stone, dominant in Black Galaxy and Absolute Black granite. Also makes diamond wire, quartz surfaces and develops heavy mineral sands.
RevenueStreams: Granite slabs and stone (core); quartz surfaces; diamond wire; emerging heavy mineral sands; revenue Rs 422 crore (FY26)
Expenses: Total expenses 66% of sales (FY26) - mining and processing costs dominate; depreciation Rs 19 crore; interest Rs 8 crore
TAM: Indian natural stone industry ~USD 5+ billion with large export share; quartz growing 10%+ globally (sourced figure data not found)
PL_Top3_Contributors: Granite export realisations on scarce Black Galaxy quarries; mining/processing costs; new quartz and mineral sands ventures
